title: Will Donald Trump's VoteHub approval polling average be above 36.9% at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 16, 2026?
rules: If Donald Trump's VoteHub approval polling average is above 36.9% at 10:00 AM ET on Oct 16, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

blind.reasoning: VoteHub had Trump at 38.0% approval on Sept 23. Since then, low polls (Reuters/Ipsos 32, Pew 30, NBC 36, WSJ 37) have probably pulled it down to roughly 37.0–37.8%, consistent with Silver Bulletin at about 37–38% in early October. Over six days a smoothed average rarely moves more than about half a point, so staying above 36.9% is somewhat more likely than not, but the downward trend and uncertainty about the current value keep this close.
blind.falsifier: VoteHub's average already sits at or below 36.9% as of Oct 10, or another round of very low polls (e.g. low-30s from Ipsos/Pew-type pollsters) pushes it to 36.9% or lower by 10 AM ET on Oct 16.

final.reasoning: The 0.335 midpoint likely reflects VoteHub's live value, which I couldn't see and which may already be at or below 36.9% after the very low Pew and Ipsos polls. I moved most of the way toward the market, and the small remaining gap is too thin to bet on given that information disadvantage.
